title: Coalesce runtime-report failure notices and reduce repeated readiness CLI work during fanout
outcome: A many-check unadmitted turn produces a clear bounded failure diagnostic and avoids redundant delivery/readiness work after a report-wide refusal, without weakening policy eligibility checks or immutable replay.
acceptance: A report-wide definitive refusal or local policy failure produces one clear diagnostic per report while retaining each check's truthful terminal outcome; a 70-check producer-boundary test covers it.
Readiness work during fanout is reduced or explicitly bounded without reusing an invalid eligibility proof, changing a retained request, dropping checks or reminting its token.
The maintained full gate passes on the exact input.
